website_summary.name: EuroTravel Explorer
website_summary.description: The EuroTravel Explorer website presents an elegant interface with a focus on showcasing tourist attractions and campsites in various European countries, designed with a user-friendly search and booking system.
website_summary.appearance: The website EuroTravel Explorer features a clean and organized layout with a search bar prominently displayed at the top center for user convenience. It includes categories for different countries, each illustrated with an image, title, and a brief description indicating the number of cities featured. Currently, the design uses a light background with controls in blue, but per the requirement, it should be updated to a light pink background with medium violet red for controls. The overall visual aesthetic is straightforward, ensuring easy navigation and a professional appearance.
website_summary.functionality: The website includes a searchable function that allows users to find specific destinations or campsites. It also has navigation buttons for 'Home' and 'Bookings', enabling users to either return to the main page or proceed to the section where they can manage their bookings. Users can explore destinations visually, as European countries are presented with attractive images and brief descriptions. The website aims to facilitate the booking process and provide user reviews for various attractions and campsites.

functionality_testing.name: Search Bar Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that entering a country name into the search bar (Search Bar) and pressing Enter displays relevant results.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The search bar is empty and ready for input.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The page should display a list of destinations and campsites related to Italy. 7. Next Steps : Enter "Italy" into the search bar and press Enter to initiate the search.
procedure: Type "Italy" into the search bar (Search Bar).
Press Enter.
Verify that the page updates to show relevant results for Italy.

functionality_testing.name: Search Execution Test

functionality_testing.preconditions: The search bar contains the text "Italy."

Next Steps : Execute the search query by pressing Enter to see if relevant results related to Italy are displayed.
